Bench: Alok Kumar Verma

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  17.01.2024 ABA No.69 of 2024  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Present Application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory Bail under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 218, 120 B of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, Section 13(1)(a) and Section 13(1)(c) read with Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 in connection with the First Information Report No.10 of 2023, registered at Vigilance Sector, District Dehradun.
2. Mr. Pradeep Kumar Chauhan, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. S.C. Dhumka, learned A.G.A. for State.
3. Learned counsel for the State has sought four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
4. Mr. Pradeep Kumar Chauhan, Advocate, contended that the applicant, aged about 65 years, has been falsely implicated in the present matter.

He was Sub-Registrar in the office of Sub-Registrar,
Haridwar from the year, 2006 till 2011.
He does not have any criminal antecedents.

He is a permanent resident of District Dehradun, therefore, there is no chance of his absconding, and co-accused persons have already been granted Interim Anticipatory Bail by this Court.
of 2024 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.

6. In the facts and circumstances of the case, applicant- Maya Ram Joshi is directed to be released on Interim Anticipatory Bail, in the event of his arrest, on furnishing his personal bond of Rs.
30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount on the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available at the time of interrogation by the Investigating Agency as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.

(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) Vacation Judge 17.01.2024 RV ABA/69/2024 on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103441238/
